review: The only semantic selector change permits explicit github-release-asset records for android in addition to macos. Windows remote storage remains unsupported. Android retains exact single file descriptor, .apk suffix, safe basename, lowercase SHA256/positive integer byte count, game/version tag, exact ecojust/pureTV URL with no query/fragment, positive integer release/asset IDs, and rejection of any local file/directory/dangling symlink at the declared path.

Remote records are metadata only and never enter declared local output/exclusion results. Complete Git selection still rejects a tracked-but-missing package/source path. This change does not silently exempt a remote-looking source file.

Optional android directory permits only a source-bound README plus exact SHA256SUMS entries for declared remote APK; unknown build.mjs/other content, altered checksum, extra node, symlink and path aliases remain rejected. Original local APK/ZIP/DMG/EXE hash, content format and file-completeness checks are unchanged.

Three new tests cover exact Android remote identity/invalid ID/version/path/url/storage/hash/size, conflicts with local file/directory/link, checksum mismatch, missing tracked input and undeclared source in android index. Old test bodies/helpers remain unchanged.

tests.evidenceKind: Root verification.json and corresponding source review; no independent native/platform test run

limits: This is source selection support, not remote package validation or publication. It neither downloads nor verifies a Release asset.
No actual new Backroad published Android metadata exists in this check. Root reports Android publication paused after a visual issue; this review does not grant delivery or upload acceptance.
